exposure: TOLAC group vs. no TOLAC group
cohort: 536 women with one previous cesarean delivery and a subsequent second delivery between 2009 and 2016
finding: Among patients with a first cesarean delivery, a history of preterm delivery was negatively correlated with a subsequent trial of labor, while patient age, body mass index, and gestational comorbidities negatively affected trial of labor rates in the subsequent delivery.
mod_finding: Patients with a history of preterm delivery in their first pregnancy were less likely to have a trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC) in their second pregnancy.
